Scaffold adopted: .github/workflows/gates.yml and .pre-commit-config.yaml at the repository root. The CI harness job runs the package's own gate runner.

requirements-dev.txt pins the three gate tools exactly. Not a true lockfile — generating one needs network access unavailable in this sandbox — but the tools have no transitive dependencies worth locking.
POST /v1/run requires a constant-time bearer token; serve() refuses non-loopback binds without one.

run_shell remains cwd-confined rather than isolated. Not fixable while it is a general shell; a denylist would give false assurance. Stated as a limitation; containment belongs at the container boundary.
templates/.../gates.sh detects uv/pnpm instead of assuming them, and scopes mypy to src/ when present.

unverified: The pre-commit hooks are configuration only. pre-commit is not installed in this sandbox and cannot be fetched, so the YAML parses but the hooks have never run.
The GitHub Actions workflow has not executed. Both job bodies were run by hand locally and pass; the workflow syntax is valid YAML but untested by Actions itself.
No live Anthropic API call was made at any point. AnthropicClient is exercised through an injected fake transport, never against the real endpoint.
The Docker image was not built.
run_shell is cwd-confined, not isolated (ADR-006). Deliberate, not an oversight.

defects_found_and_fixed_this_session.detail: Config.workspace defaulted to Path.cwd() evaluated at class-creation time, so any Config built after a chdir carried the interpreter's start-up directory as its sandbox root. Now field(default_factory=Path.cwd).

defects_found_and_fixed_this_session.found_by: end-to-end smoke test of the CLI binary (not caught by 215 unit tests)
defects_found_and_fixed_this_session.detail: A blank AGENTAGENT2_API_TOKEN left api_token == '' rather than None, so serve() bound non-loopback addresses without complaint and 'Authorization: Bearer ' (empty) authenticated against it via compare_digest. Net effect: a publicly bound RCE endpoint that reported itself as authenticated. .env.example ships the token blank, which is precisely the triggering configuration. Config.__post_init__ now collapses blank tokens to None. Verified against a live server: healthz 200, no/wrong/empty token 401, correct token 200.
